facts.text: Brownfields lies 10 miles northeast of downtown Baton Rouge, within the Baton Rouge metropolitan statistical area.
The Comite River, a south‑flowing tributary of the Amite River, marks Brownfields’ eastern boundary with Central.
In late 2004, local stakeholders pushed for a state brownfields organization, sparking the creation of the Louisiana Brownfields Association.
The Louisiana Brownfields Association was officially founded in July 2006, aiming to promote environmental restoration, economic revitalization, and public health.
By 2014, the association secured 501(c)(6) nonprofit status, expanding its ability to offer financial and regulatory incentives for redevelopment.
Brownfields’ community schools include Brownfields Elementary and Sharon Hills Elementary, with some students zoned to Central schools for higher grades.
